title: A bound on stalk generators extends to a neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $F$ be a finite-type sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], let $x\in X$, and let $r\geq0$. The stalk $F_x$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] can be generated by $r$ elements over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ if and only if there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and $r$ sections generating $F|_U$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Families of exactly $r$ elements express the bound at most $r$ by zero padding. Neither quasi-coherence nor finite presentation is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01B8, lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk; representation of a finite family of germs on a common neighbourhood

proof.text: Represent a finite family of module germs and the finitely many scalar germs on common neighbourhoods, using the stalk description of [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Finite intersections remain open. Equality of germs becomes equality after shrinking, simultaneously for finitely many equalities. This also applies to an empty family, taking the empty intersection to be the whole space.

Suppose r elements span the stalk. Represent them by r sections on an open U. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-local-coefficients], choose finitely many local generators a_i on an open V containing x. Express each germ of a_i as a finite linear combination of the r germs. Apply the preceding finite representation and equality argument to all coefficients and all equations. On the resulting neighbourhood W, every a_i is a linear combination of the chosen r sections. For an arbitrary section near any point of W, the local coefficient formula for a_i therefore lifts it locally through the free sheaf on the r sections. The sheaf epimorphism criterion proves that these r sections generate F on W.

source.place: Tag 01B8, lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk; representation of a finite family of germs on a common neighbourhood

proof.text: Conversely, for an epimorphism from the free sheaf on r sections over U, [lem-weil-pbc-local-module-epi-germ-lift] lifts a representative of any target germ on a smaller neighbourhood. A section of a finite free sheaf is the sum of its coordinate sections. Apply the morphism and take germs to express the original germ in the span of the r generator germs. The empty sum gives the case r=0.

theorem finite_stalk_generators_iff_neighbourhood (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] (x : X) (r : ℕ) :
    (∃ s : Fin r → (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F,
      Submodule.span (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Set.range s) = ⊤) ↔
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ s : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → (F.over U).sections,
        Epi ((F.over U).freeHomEquiv.symm s)
